generation.method: Generated mechanically from real Orca captures. No response key, type, command exit, or scalar value was entered by hand.

schemaSemantics.scalarValues: No captured scalar response value is retained. Its normalized path records only JSON type and timestamp format when applicable.
schemaSemantics.objects: Child paths are the complete union of keys observed at each object location.
schemaSemantics.arrays: A [] path segment is derived from every observed array element and preserves every child key and conflicting JSON type. No [] path exists when every observed array was empty.
schemaSemantics.timestamps: date-time means the captured string matched an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp and parsed as a date.

issueDefault.commandCompleteness: complete argv with issue and team identifiers replaced
issueDefault.redactionAndStripping: Replaced issue and team command values. Removed every response scalar value, stdout text, stderr text, signal value, and spawn error value. Retained every normalized response path, all observed JSON types, ISO-8601 timestamp format metadata, and array lengths. Array item paths use [] and union all observed item shapes.
